title: EPOWER Energy Intelligence
description: Specification for generating a Wimmel-style illustration covering all 4 modules of the EPOWER Hands-On Lab. The picture visualizes EPOWER's business model as a German energy retailer and the Snowflake AI Data Cloud — the unified platform that brings together Data and AI under one governance umbrella.

critical_labels.NOTE: The following labels MUST appear EXACTLY as written in the generated image. Do NOT alter spelling, numbers, or wording.
critical_labels.platform_name: Snowflake AI Data Cloud (NOT 'AI Data Platform', NOT 'Data Cloud Platform' — exactly 'Snowflake AI Data Cloud')
critical_labels.prosumer_label: Prosumer (households with solar panels that both produce and consume energy must be labeled 'Prosumer')

format.style: Friendly, modern Wimmel-style (Wimmelbild) vector art with clean lines and vivid colors. Approachable, optimistic, slightly playful — like a tech company infographic crossed with a Where's Waldo scene. NOT overly futuristic or intimidating. People look happy, relaxed, collaborative. The AI agent is small, humble, and helpful — not dominant or scary.
format.mood: Positive, optimistic, grounded, fun. Shows technology serving people and the planet. The feeling of a thriving community powered by smart energy and intelligent data.

layout.description: The picture tells the EPOWER business story from left to right: Physical Energy World (left) → Snowflake AI Data Cloud (center, slim) → Business Operations & Applications (right). The left and right zones dominate the visual space — they show the real-world business case. The center is the Snowflake AI Data Cloud — a unified platform encompassing data layers, AI capabilities, AND Snowflake CoWork (the AI assistant). The bottom shows external source systems with simple arrows feeding the platform.

zones.center: Snowflake AI Data Cloud (encompasses medallion data layers + dbt transformation + CoWork AI assistant + Semantic Views + Cortex Search + MCP) — SLIM but vertically tall, not dominant in width
zones.left: Physical energy world (homes, VPP, prosumers, grid, 360° energy strategy) — LARGE, dominant
zones.right: Enterprise AI in Action (HQ, portal, apps, control room) — LARGE, dominant
zones.bottom: External source systems (CRM, HR, Postgres, Energy Charts API, Documents) with simple arrows

center_hub.title: Snowflake AI Data Cloud
center_hub.rendering_instruction: Do NOT render a box labeled 'Main Center Hub' or 'center_hub'. The visible header is 'Snowflake AI Data Cloud'. Do NOT show any JSON field names as labels.
center_hub.structure: Single vertical column from bottom to top: Bronze → Silver → Gold → Context Layer → CoWork icon. All enclosed in one boundary labeled 'Snowflake AI Data Cloud' at the top.

elements.label: RAW Data (Bronze)

elements.visual: Clean silver/grey tinted band in the MIDDLE of the stack. No icons inside — just the color and label.
elements.label: Cleansed Data (Silver)

elements.name: Transformation Engine
elements.visual: dbt logo positioned beside the medallion layers with a small directed-acyclic-graph (DAG) icon showing nodes connected by arrows (representing a data pipeline flow Bronze → Silver → Gold). No standalone arrows — use the graph/DAG visual to indicate pipeline progression. Clearly labeled 'Snowflake dbt-projects'.

elements.name: Context Layer for AI
elements.visual: Above the Gold layer, within the same platform boundary: Semantic Views (small tags: Sales, Service, Customer, HR, VPP Telemetry, Market Prices — NO eye or lens icons) on one side, and Cortex Search (magnifying glass over stacked documents, '9 Search Services') on the other. Together they form the Context Layer for AI. Do NOT draw eyes, lenses, or eyeball shapes for Semantic Views.
elements.label: Context Layer for AI (Semantic Views + Cortex Search)

left_energy_world.title: Energy Prosumers in Action
left_energy_world.description: Cozy German residential neighborhood (as in a Wimmelbild) showing EPOWER's 360-degree energy strategy. The scene should look like a warm, lived-in neighborhood with houses, gardens, trees, bikes, people going about daily life — NOT a technical diagram. Houses have solar panels organically on rooftops. Small details everywhere (cats on roofs, kids on bikes, vegetable gardens, recycling bins). NO large standalone technical boxes or panels in the neighborhood — keep it naturalistic.

elements.name: Prosumer Homes
elements.visual: Cozy German residential houses with solar panels on rooftops, labeled 'Prosumer'. Small battery units subtly integrated into garages (NOT large black standalone boxes). The neighborhood looks natural and lived-in — gardens, driveways, trees. IMPORTANT: Each house with solar panels MUST have a visible label reading 'Prosumer'.
details: Heat pump next to house (no gas!)
EV wallbox with electric car charging
Smart meter on wall showing kWh
Visible 'Prosumer' label on or near each solar-equipped house
NO large black VPP boxes — batteries are small, integrated into garages

elements.name: VPP Revenue Split
elements.visual: IMPORTANT: The revenue split is exactly 70/30 (seventy/thirty, NOT 70/20). Show a small coin-split icon labeled '70/30' — 70% to homeowner (Prosumer), 30% to EPOWER. Keep it subtle, integrated into the neighborhood scene — NOT a large separate box or panel.

elements.label: Consumer — Grid Only

business_value_narrative.description: The picture should tell the story of business value, not just technology. Each zone demonstrates a business outcome enabled by Snowflake.

value_stories.business_value: Customers earn money from their batteries. EPOWER gets recurring revenue. Grid becomes more stable.
value_stories.snowflake_enabler: Real-time IoT analytics + price optimization via dbt pipelines

value_stories.business_value: Any employee can get insights instantly — no waiting for analyst reports, no SQL skills needed. A personal AI Work Assistant for everyone at EPOWER.

value_stories.business_value: Operational data instantly available for analytics — no ETL pipelines to build or maintain.
New data sources onboarded in minutes, not days. Data team velocity dramatically increased.
Custom applications built on Agent REST API — embed intelligence anywhere.

do_not_include: Scary or intimidating AI imagery (no glowing red eyes, no Terminator vibes)
Generic cloud computing imagery without business context
Abstract data visualizations without connection to energy domain
Overly complex technical diagrams that look like architecture documents
Any elements unrelated to energy retail / Snowflake AI narrative
References to 'two-phase' or 'heuristic' telemetry — all VPP data is price-reactive
Competitors' logos or branding (except subtle real-world VPP references: 1KOMMA5, Sonnen)

generation_notes.prompt_style: Use this JSON as a structured brief for image generation AI (DALL-E, Midjourney, Gemini Imagen). Convert the relevant sections into a natural language prompt, emphasizing the mood, layout, and key scenes.
generation_notes.iterations: The picture may need 2-3 iterations. First get the layout and mood right, then refine labels and details.
generation_notes.resolution: Target 3840x2160 (4K) for print quality, export at 1920x1080 for web/README use.
